verses.raw: The repentance accepted by Allāh is only for those who do wrong in ignorance [or carelessness] and then repent soon [after].<sup foot_note=254178>1</sup> It is those to whom Allāh will turn in forgiveness, and Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
verses.text: The repentance accepted by Allāh is only for those who do wrong in ignorance [or carelessness] and then repent soon [after]. It is those to whom Allāh will turn in forgiveness, and Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

verses.raw: But repentance is not [accepted] of those who [continue to] do evil deeds up until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "Indeed, I have repented now," or of those who die while they are disbelievers. For them We have prepared a painful punishment.
